description.value: Shunfeng Seafood Restaurant is a large-format Cantonese dining destination in Richmond's Number 3 Road corridor, spanning 8,000 square feet with capacity for over 350 guests. It is known for award-winning dim sum as well as elaborate wedding banquets and private VIP dining rooms on a mezzanine level. Located in a shopping centre near the SkyTrain and Vancouver International Airport, it draws a broad clientele looking for full-service Chinese cuisine.
